solution.text:
Since, x→, y→ and x→×y→ are 3 non-coplanar vectors
Hence, a-3α2+b-4α+c-1=0
a-3β2+b-4β+c-1=0
a-3γ2+b-4γ+c-1=0
We can say that a-3x2+b-4x+c-1=0 has roots α,β,γ
Since, quadratic has 3 roots so it becomes an identity
⇒a-3=0, b-4=0, c-1=0
⇒a=3, b=4, c=1
⇒a2+b2+c24=264=6.5
